name: Scavenger
notes: Unarmed, with a claw on the bow and a tank behind the core that starts a fifth full, so it is cheap to send out and has to scavenge. Below three quarters of a full load it goes for the wreck, or the disarmed enemy, that pays most fuel for the time it takes, avoiding any an armed enemy is near; it brings the claw in at a walking pace, drinks, and moves on to the next until it is full.

modules.notes: Sent out a fifth full: fuel it can drink from a wreck is fuel it does not have to be built with, so it costs less of a budget.
Its jaws are the bow, so pointing the ship at a wreck is pointing the claw.
